name: MASSFRONT
install: npm install && python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -q openpyxl && node tools/bundle.mjs && node tools/pack-www.mjs

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: node tools/bundle.mjs; node tools/pack-www.mjs && node serve.mjs www 8901
terminals.description: Runs the syntax gate (tools/bundle.mjs — parses the whole concatenated source and fails on global collisions), stages www/ fresh from the checked-out source (tools/pack-www.mjs — also verifies nothing 404s), then serves the game at http://127.0.0.1:8901. After editing anything under src/, re-run `node tools/bundle.mjs && node tools/pack-www.mjs` and reload. NOTE: the WebGL2 battle renderer requires a hardware GPU; on a GPU-less VM the menu loads but the game shows 'WEBGL2 REQUIRED'.
